summary.interpretation: Run #2 demonstrated improved recognition of one-sided bounds and safe rejection of unsupported semantics, but also exposed numeric/unit canonicalization, source attribution, conditional representation, and sampling-classification limitations.

reference_normalized_constraints: For every valve: pneumatic proof-test pressure >= 1.5 × MEOP.

judgment.reason: Minimum proof-pressure meaning and lower-bound type were identified, but numeric and unit semantics were not canonically separated: min contained '1.5xMEOP'.

reference_normalized_constraints: For every unit during assembly: apply pressure individually to each line.
For every unit during assembly: separately apply pressure to the valve housing through the actuation ram chamber while the lines are vented.

judgment.reason: Prototype extracted numeric helium-leak constraints from an unnumbered normative paragraph attached to the NCPR 19 block rather than representing the numbered NCPR 19 coverage/procedural requirement.

reference_normalized_constraints: Test all valve parts exposed to pressure after valve actuation.

judgment.reason: Coverage/procedural requirement is outside the currently supported mathematical constraint types and was routed to review.

reference_normalized_constraints: For all welds: leak testing shall occur during assembly OR acceptance testing.

judgment.reason: Coverage plus logical-OR procedural semantics were not forced into an unsupported numeric constraint.

reference_normalized_constraints: Perform non-destructive acceptance testing OR mitigate defect risk through process control.

judgment.reason: Alternative NDT/process-control requirement was safely routed to review.

reference_normalized_constraints: IF process control is used AND programmatic requirements require this approval for the spacecraft, THEN obtain NASA Fracture Control Board approval.

judgment.reason: Conditional approval/governance requirement was not approximated as a supported numeric constraint.

reference_normalized_constraints: IF fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis are used to verify NASA-STD-5019 compliance, THEN demonstrate to the fracture control authority that growth of the maximum credible crack size is non-credible.
Base the demonstration on knowledge of quality-control and manufacturing techniques used to make the valve.

judgment.reason: Fracture-mechanics/crack-growth requirement requires external analysis and was safely kept outside the deterministic constraint scope.

reference_normalized_constraints: Valve survival capability >= 4 × design operational life.

judgment.reason: The four-times operational-life relationship contains a numeric multiplier, but that relationship is not represented by the current constraint schema.

reference_normalized_constraints: IF the valve design provides two separate and independent parent-metal barriers before actuation, THEN apply proof pressure >= 1.5 × MEOP independently to each parent-metal shear-section.
Then apply the proof test externally to the shear-section when welded in the housing.
During LAT: no evidence of permanent deformation AND no leakage.

judgment.reason: Requirement combines conditional applicability, location-specific proof testing, coverage, and no-deformation/no-leakage semantics. Prototype safely routed the compound requirement to review.

reference_normalized_constraints: For each burst-pressure test: hold time >= 5 min.

judgment.reason: Hold-time lower bound was extracted as lower_bound with min=5 and unit=min and was accepted by the deterministic AI-to-Core adapter.

reference_normalized_constraints: IF line diameter >= 3.8 cm (>= 1.5 in), THEN minimum design burst pressure >= 2.5 × MEOP.
IF line diameter < 3.8 cm (< 1.5 in), THEN minimum design burst pressure >= 4.0 × MEOP.

judgment.reason: Both 2.5xMEOP and 4.0xMEOP branches were identified as lower bounds, but conditional branch semantics are not structurally supported and multiplier values were not canonically separated from units.

reference_normalized_constraints: For each valve lot: number of NC parent-metal valves demonstrating the applicable burst-pressure capability >= 1.

judgment.reason: Reference contains an explicit per-lot count threshold >= 1, but Prototype classified the sampling requirement as unsupported. The miss was safely routed to review rather than forced into the Core.
